import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
contact_material = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()
contact_material.SetFriction(0.9)
contact_material.SetRestitution(0.1)
contact_material.SetYoungModulus(1e8)
contact_material.SetCompliance(1e-6)

# Create the vehicle

hmmwv.SetContactMaterial(contact_material)
hmmwv.SetChassisVisualization(chrono.ChVisualizationType.PRIMITIVE)
hmmwv.SetSuspensionVisualization(chrono.ChVisualizationType.PRIMITIVE)
hmmwv.SetSteeringVisualization(chrono.ChVisualizationType.PRIMITIVE)
hmmwv.SetWheelVisualization(chrono.ChVisualizationType.PRIMITIVE)
hmmwv.SetTireModel(chrono_vehicle.TireModelType.TMEASY)

# Initialize the vehicle with specific parameters
hmmwv.SetLocation(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.5))
hmmwv.SetOrientation(chrono.ChQuaternionD(1, 0, 0, 0))
hmmwv.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethodType.NSC)

# Create the terrain
terrain = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(system, 10, 10, 0.1, 1000, True, contact_material)
terrain.SetBodyFixed(True)
terrain.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -0.1))
terrain.SetMaterialTexture(chrono.ChTexture("terrain", "texture.jpg"))

# Create the visualization
visualizer = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht(system)
visualizer.SetWindowSize(800, 600)
visualizer.SetWindowTitle("HMMWV Simulation")
visualizer.SetCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1.5), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 1, 0))

# Create the interactive driver system
driver = chrono_vehicle.ChIrrlichtDriver()
driver.SetVehicle(hmmwv)
driver.SetSteeringMin(-0.5)
driver.SetSteeringMax(0.5)
driver.SetThrottleMin(0)
driver.SetThrottleMax(10)
driver.SetBrakingMin(0)
driver.SetBrakingMax(10)

# Set up the simulation loop
stepping = chrono.ChTimestepperType.RK4
system.SetTimestepperType(stepping)
system.SetMaxPenetrationRecoverySpeed(1.0)
system.SetMinBounceSpeed(0.1)
system.SetSolverType(chrono.ChSolverType.APGD)

# Run the simulation loop
while visualizer.Run():
    system.DoStepDynamics(0.02)
    visualizer.BeginScene()
    visualizer.DrawAll()
    visualizer.EndScene()
    driver.Synchronize(0.02)
    chrono.ChUtils::Sleep(0.02)

path.AddBezierPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(10, 0, 0))
path.AddBezierPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(20, 10, 0))
path.AddBezierPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(20, 20, 0))
path.AddBezierPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(10, 20, 0))
path.AddBezierPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 20, 0))
path.AddBezierPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 10, 0))
path.AddBezierPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0))

# Create a path follower driver system
driver = veh.ChPathFollowerDriver(path)
driver.SetThrottle(0.3)
driver.SetSteeringPID(chrono.ChVector3d(1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
driver.SetLookAheadDistance(5.0)
driver.SetPathFollowerType(veh.PathFollowerType_CENTROIDAL)

# Initialize the driver system
driver.Initialize()

# Output vehicle mass
print("VEHICLE MASS: ", vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = int(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

# Create visualization for the path
path_vis = chrono.ChVisualization()
path_vis.SetRenderMode(chrono.ChVisualization.RENDER_MODE_WIREFRAME)
vis.AddVisualization(path_vis)

# Create visualization for the sentinel and target points
sentinel_vis = chrono.ChVisualization()
sentinel_vis.SetRenderMode(chrono.ChVisualization.RENDER_MODE_WIREFRAME)
vis.AddVisualization(sentinel_vis)

target_vis = chrono.ChVisualization()
target_vis.SetRenderMode(chrono.ChVisualization.RENDER_MODE_WIREFRAME)
vis.AddVisualization(target_vis)

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if step_number % render_steps == 0:
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver.GetInputs(), terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver.GetInputs())

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Visualize the path
    path_vis.Clear()
    path_vis.AddLine(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.ChVector3d(10, 0, 0))
    path_vis.AddLine(chrono.ChVector3d(10, 0, 0), chrono.ChVector3d(20, 10, 0))
    path_vis.AddLine(chrono.ChVector3d(20, 10, 0), chrono.ChVector3d(20, 20, 0))
    path_vis.AddLine(chrono.ChVector3d(20, 20, 0), chrono.ChVector3d(10, 20, 0))
    path_vis.AddLine(chrono.ChVector3d(10, 20, 0), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 20, 0))
    path_vis.AddLine(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 20, 0), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 10, 0))
    path_vis.AddLine(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 10, 0), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0))

    # Visualize the sentinel and target points
    sentinel_vis.Clear()
    sentinel_vis.AddSphere(driver.GetSentinelPoint(), 0.5)

    target_vis.Clear()
    target_vis.AddSphere(driver.GetTargetPoint(), 0.5)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1
